purpose: Show that apparent metric-like ordering can be discussed as a provisional candidate without collapsing into a completed metric, topology, manifold, or physical measurement rule.

counterexample_case.label: Shared ordinal profile, broken context preservation
counterexample_case.setup: Trace T1 and Trace T2 both record LOW_MISMATCH -> MODERATE_MISMATCH -> HIGH_MISMATCH under repeated Delta evaluation. T1 uses Ctx_058_A with BDRY_058_A, while T2 uses Ctx_058_D with BDRY_058_D and a different declared residue-asymmetry parameter.
counterexample_case.result: The two traces can be organized as a provisional metric-like candidate while still failing to determine a completed metric, a metric space, a topology, a manifold, or a physical measurement rule.
